text: Web: reordering categories in list properties swaps raw category_order positions, so a hidden entry makes an arrow press do nothing

Fixed in ccad969: normalizeCategoryOrder (web) / CategoryCanon.normalizeOrder (Android) extracted from the rename plan and used for every write of the order and for Android's display list; the web page moves/adds/removes in terms of the normalised order, saves it clean, and disables the arrows at the ends. Tests: stale-duplicate case moves in one press and saves ['Bread','Dairy']; end arrows disabled; plain swap; helper pinned on both clients. Fails with the normalisation removed. Gate green (server 461, web 404, Android). The one Android failure seen during iteration was the T-209 flake, A/B-confirmed independent of this change.
